title: Product & Technical Lead: Learning Analytics & Student Support
summary: Leading multidisciplinary teams of developers, business analysts, and service-area experts to transform the university's Salesforce platform and student support services. Responsible for product strategy, product design, technical architecture, and implementation across MyPlymouth, integrated enquiry services, and responsible learning analytics.

projects.title: MyPlymouth Platform for Students & Staff
projects.body: Led the product strategy, design, architecture, and end-to-end implementation of MyPlymouth: a comprehensive redesign and rebrand of the university's Salesforce platform. MyPlymouth brings legacy capabilities into a clearer, modern platform with dedicated experiences for students, academics, professional services, and support staff. It also provides the foundation for new integrated services, including referrals, a knowledge base, student enquiries, a student-facing chatbot, and insights that help staff and students understand patterns of engagement. The platform is currently being launched progressively across its user groups.
projects.summary: A modern, integrated Salesforce platform supporting the entire student journey.

projects.title: Learning Analytics for Early Intervention
projects.body: Led the strategy, product design, architecture, implementation, and operating-model development of a learning analytics service designed to identify students who may benefit from additional support early in their university journey. The platform brings together defined engagement indicators, including use of digital services, lecture attendance, enrolment completion, and the frequency of other early university touchpoints. It prioritises students who may merit attention, enabling trained student ambassadors to make supportive contact, understand their circumstances, and direct them towards relevant services and resources. The service supports structured follow-up when initial engagement concerns appear unresolved and established Plymouth University's first student ambassador outreach service of its kind. A comprehensive operating policy defines which data may be used, how it is handled, and the legitimate support purposes for which it can be applied. Selected insights are surfaced through MyPlymouth, while the learning analytics service remains a distinct product and workstream.
projects.award: Vice-Chancellor's Award for Supporting a Great Student Experience — Highly Commended
projects.summary: Responsible learning analytics enabling timely, student-led support.

projects.title: Integrated Student Enquiry & Support Service
projects.body: Led the design and implementation of a new institution-wide student enquiry and support service within MyPlymouth. The service replaced fragmented processes based on email, spreadsheets, and independently operated team systems. It brings together faculty offices, careers, the Student Hub, disability services, and wellbeing teams, giving authorised staff a more complete view of each student's support journey. Students can track the progress of their enquiries, see which team is responsible, follow transfers between services, and know when an enquiry has been resolved. Referrals and longer-running support or wellbeing interventions can begin from the same joined-up journey. The work also included redesigning how front-line teams collaborate and operate. Consistent service data now makes it possible to identify recurring issues and support ongoing service improvement. The service has been fully rolled out across the participating teams and is in comprehensive use.
projects.summary: A joined-up enquiry and support journey for students and staff.

title: Digital Education Product Manager
summary: Building a first class student success platform for the Faculty of Medicine and Dentistry. Member of multiple faculty committees.

projects.title: PULSE Student Success Platform
projects.body: Led the design and implementation of a comprehensive student success platform for the Faculty of Medicine and Dentistry at Plymouth University, encompassing a wide range of modules to support the entire student journey from concept to launch. My role involved stakeholder engagement, requirements gathering, UX/UI design, and managing the agile development process. The platform now serves 1,200+ students daily and has reduced administrative overhead by 30%.
projects.summary: Transforming Medical Education at Plymouth University.

projects.title: Content Adaptive Progress Testing
projects.body: Designed and implemented a sophisticated assessment platform delivering content-adaptive progress testing and topic mapping for medical students. Introduced an industry-first feedback system to enable longitudinal personalised learning feedback to medical students against the GMC topic map. Coinciding and enabling dynamic assessment of students based on past assessment performance.

projects.title: On-Clinic Dental Experience Assessment
projects.body: Digitised the assessment of clinical dental experience, replacing paper logs and enabling real-time progression tracking via a specialised mobile-friendly tool for recording and validating clinical experience in dental clinics. Providing process assurance for patient safety and enabling students to work towards their longitudinal GDC requirements. Also enabled capacity management to ensure patient availability for student needs and scheduling. Used across clinical sites across the south-west of England in collaboration with PDSE and the #1 ranked dental school in the UK.

projects.title: Competency Based Assessment
projects.body: System for tracking and verifying student competency across practical skills, enabling faculty to monitor progression and ensure students meet professional standards.

projects.title: Short Courses Platform
projects.body: A web-based platform handling booking, payment, and management of short professional development courses for continuing education.

title: Product Architect; Senior UX Designer
summary: Leading UX and product design, building campaign management and reporting tools for a cutting-edge AdTech platform.

projects.title: iotec Horizon Platform Interface
projects.body: Led the design and implementation of a self-service campaign management and reporting web interface, enabling advanced configuration, setup, and performance monitoring for internal teams and professional clients, including self-service capabilities for high-value accounts. I led the entire product design lifecycle, from user research and wireframing to high-fidelity prototypes and front-end development support. The platform was fully internationalised for major European markets to enable strategic expansion, achieving an 80% reduction in campaign setup time and enabling the business to scale to 200+ clients.
projects.summary: Campaign management and reporting for high-scale AdTech.

projects.title: iotec Platform RESTful API
projects.body: Led the development of a RESTful API for the iotec Horizon Platform — a key enabling strategic functionality for the self-service Horizon platform interface — enabling seamless integration with external systems and applications as well as a unified platform for developing new products and features internally.
